load_camembert_pretrained: load a pretrained CamemBERT French language model using from_pretrained with a model name or path
list_camembert_hub_models: list all available CamemBERT model variants and their download URLs via the hub_models classmethod
use_camembert_interface: use the RobertaHubInterface returned by from_pretrained to run French NLP inference tasks
register_camembert_model: register the CamembertModel class as the camembert model type in fairseq using the register_model decorator
review_camembert_model_class: review the CamembertModel class which extends RobertaModel for French language model support
